params.message:
Read the original for remove.bg with a retry, and send nothing without bytes

The vehicles disk answers a failed read with null, which went to
remove.bg as an empty image and came back as a reported 400
missing_source. Read through readSource() with one retry: a file that
is not there is SOURCE_MISSING, one whose bytes do not come twice is a
reported storage fault. Nothing is sent without bytes.

Nightwatch: 61
Portal: A photo whose file the storage briefly did not return is no longer sent empty to the background removal service.
